Fields.Name: Map ID
Fields.Description: The sky map as 8 digits AABBCCDD (e.g. 10000099 for m10_00_00_99). Only rows with DD 99 are loaded (98 instead in an alternate game state); open-world rows need BB and CC 00 (60000099, 61000099).

Fields.Name: Weather
Fields.Description: The weather (WeatherParam row ID) in which this row's assets are shown.

Fields.Name: Is Burning Ash
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not to adapt to the fire ash state of the map.

Fields.Name: Asset ID [0]
Fields.Description: Asset model shown in this weather (AEG999_999 -> 999999), matched against the map's asset parts. -1: none.
